title: items.json - things the player can pick up and examine (U17; U19: the feeling is a separate panel)

photo.description: image path relative to the game root (checked by check-media); empty only while the picture is not made yet

feeling.description: the protagonist's one-line impression, shown in its own panel (U19)

kind.description: what it is (js/item-kinds.js ITEM_KINDS: key card paper clipboard book photo tag tape talisman bag bottle box phone flashlight tool cloth jar battery): shown as that model, resting on what is under it (standard 1.7)

given.description: a task id: not placed in the world; the task gives it when it is done (standard 1.7)

y.description: the support height above the room's floor (default: the surface under x, z)
